Aviation Maintenance Tools is a professional maintenance reference app for aircraft technicians, focused on A320 troubleshooting and ECAM reset procedures.
It provides fast, structured access to key information used during fault troubleshooting, reset procedures, structural damage report creation, and everyday maintenance tasks—helping technicians work more efficiently on the line or in base maintenance.

ECAM Fault Messages

• Extensive database of fault messages with the associated circuit breakers (CBs) required for each A320 ECAM reset
• Images of aircraft panels showing where to find each circuit breaker
• Clear, step-by-step ECAM reset procedures with an integrated countdown
• Maintenance manual and MEL references linked to each message

Quick Fault Search

• Instantly find messages using a fast search engine, reducing time-consuming searches during line maintenance calls
• Browse messages organized by ATA chapter
• Recent tab for quick access to previously viewed content

Avionics Tour

• Interactive photo tour of the A320neo avionics compartment
• Navigate through AFT, FWD, LH MID and RH MID bays with real aircraft photos
• Tap any LRU marker to view its name, location and technical description
• Built-in search to quickly find any unit across the compartment

Structural Damage Reports

• Interactive structural damage report forms generator with support for multiple damage entries, eliminating paper notes and improving handover
• Useful for reporting a single damage or multiple damages (e.g., after lightning events)
• Attach damage photos taken with the device camera
• Export reports to PDF or ZIP files (including images) to continue working on a computer or another phone with the app

Alpha Callups

• Complete list of Alpha Callups, filtered by engine model
• Built-in search engine for quick searches

Electrical Contacts

• Electrical contacts, terminals, and splices part numbers library, with quick search function
• Direct reference to the ESPM figure where each item is located
• Crimping and insertion/extraction references included

Common Part Numbers

• Commonly used aircraft part numbers organized by category and aircraft zone
• Each part number can include a description and photos
• Add your own part numbers with photos taken using the device camera
• Create and share your custom part-number list with colleagues
• Useful for quickly finding references during line maintenance

Maintenance Manual References

• Structured breakdown of the maintenance manual index
• Fast search for quick lookup

Disclaimer – Training & Reference Use Only

This app is designed for training, reference, and informational purposes only.
This app does not replace official documentation. Fault messages, reset procedures, structural damage reports, manual/MEL/ESPM references, electrical contact data, and part number information are provided as a learning aid for maintenance technicians.
Users must always consult the latest official manuals and procedures before performing any maintenance or operational task on an aircraft.
This app must not be used as the sole source for maintenance decisions.

This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or an official product of any aircraft manufacturer.
The app does not copy, reproduce, or distribute proprietary manufacturer materials (including manual pages or documentation) and does not use manufacturer logos or branding.

New Avionics Tour for the A320 — explore the avionics compartment with interactive photo navigation and LRU descriptions
Damage reports: cleaner interface and new Save & Close button
Minor improvements across the app

• 恢复了在展开的待办事项中标题和备注字段之间的箭头键导航。
• 修复了在展开的待办事项中，标签建议未按正确顺序列出的错误。
• 修复了在展开的待办事项中，今天到期的截止日期未显示为红色的错误。
• 修复了可能导致无法为重复的待办事项设置结束日期的错误。
• 修复了将内容拖入待办事项的备注时可能出现的崩溃。
• 修复了在编辑展开的待办事项时，点按项目或区域中的•••按钮可能出现的崩溃。
• 修复了将 URL scheme 的 add 命令与检查列表项和“快速输入”搭配使用时可能出现的崩溃。


THINGS 3.23

重复的待办事项现在灵活多了，迎来两项呼声很高的改进：你现在可以提前完成它们，还可以在计划有变时轻松改期！此外，方方面面还有许多细节优化。


提前完成重复的待办事项

有时你进度超前，想提前勾掉某件事。现在可以了！重复的待办事项现在也和其他待办事项一样，显示普通的复选框，这样事情一办完，你就能将其勾选完成。


轻松改期

重复的待办事项现在可以改期了，计划有变时也能轻松应对。只需将它挪到新的日期即可。如果它是定期重复的，Things 会询问你是要创建一次性例外，还是要更新今后的重复规则。如果它是在完成后重复的，则会直接移到新的日期。


更多细节优化

我们还对重复的待办事项做了一系列优化：

• 重复待办事项的设置对话框换上了新外观，让你能更轻松地选择下一次重复的日期。
• 重复待办事项的副本现在会显示一个小小的灰色重复图标，以便与普通待办事项区分。
• 如果你想提前开始处理重复的项目，现在可以了！只要你开始编辑其中的待办事项，Things 就会提议提前创建该项目的下一个副本。
• 你还可以手动提前为重复的待办事项创建下一个副本：右键点按它，然后选择“重复 > 创建下一个副本”。
• 现在，你可以批量暂停、继续和停止多个重复的待办事项。
• 更多错误修复和改进——完整的更新说明请见我们的网站。

---

最后同样重要的是，本次更新包含一项我们已经开发了一段时间的底层重大改动：待办事项的显示与编辑（无论是在列表中，还是在展开时）在 Mac 和 iOS 上现已由同一套代码驱动。

Aviation Maintenance Tools is a professional maintenance reference app for aircraft technicians, focused on A320 troubleshooting and ECAM reset procedures.
It provides fast, structured access to key information used during fault troubleshooting, reset procedures, structural damage report creation, and everyday maintenance tasks—helping technicians work more efficiently on the line or in base maintenance.

ECAM Fault Messages

• Extensive database of fault messages with the associated circuit breakers (CBs) required for each A320 ECAM reset
• Images of aircraft panels showing where to find each circuit breaker
• Clear, step-by-step ECAM reset procedures with an integrated countdown
• Maintenance manual and MEL references linked to each message

Quick Fault Search

• Instantly find messages using a fast search engine, reducing time-consuming searches during line maintenance calls
• Browse messages organized by ATA chapter
• Recent tab for quick access to previously viewed content

Avionics Tour

• Interactive photo tour of the A320neo avionics compartment
• Navigate through AFT, FWD, LH MID and RH MID bays with real aircraft photos
• Tap any LRU marker to view its name, location and technical description
• Built-in search to quickly find any unit across the compartment

Structural Damage Reports

• Interactive structural damage report forms generator with support for multiple damage entries, eliminating paper notes and improving handover
• Useful for reporting a single damage or multiple damages (e.g., after lightning events)
• Attach damage photos taken with the device camera
• Export reports to PDF or ZIP files (including images) to continue working on a computer or another phone with the app

Alpha Callups

• Complete list of Alpha Callups, filtered by engine model
• Built-in search engine for quick searches

Electrical Contacts

• Electrical contacts, terminals, and splices part numbers library, with quick search function
• Direct reference to the ESPM figure where each item is located
• Crimping and insertion/extraction references included

Common Part Numbers

• Commonly used aircraft part numbers organized by category and aircraft zone
• Each part number can include a description and photos
• Add your own part numbers with photos taken using the device camera
• Create and share your custom part-number list with colleagues
• Useful for quickly finding references during line maintenance

Maintenance Manual References

• Structured breakdown of the maintenance manual index
• Fast search for quick lookup

Disclaimer – Training & Reference Use Only

This app is designed for training, reference, and informational purposes only.
This app does not replace official documentation. Fault messages, reset procedures, structural damage reports, manual/MEL/ESPM references, electrical contact data, and part number information are provided as a learning aid for maintenance technicians.
Users must always consult the latest official manuals and procedures before performing any maintenance or operational task on an aircraft.
This app must not be used as the sole source for maintenance decisions.

This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or an official product of any aircraft manufacturer.
The app does not copy, reproduce, or distribute proprietary manufacturer materials (including manual pages or documentation) and does not use manufacturer logos or branding.

把事情做好！獲獎肯定的 Things 應用程式幫助您規劃一天行程、管理專案，並幫助您按部就班地朝目標邁進。

除了強大的功能外，最厲害的是，使用起來非常簡單方便。在短時間內理清瑣事，無論是基本任務還是偉大的人生目標都頓時變得井然有序，然後開始專注在今天最重要的事情上。

「在所有我們測試過的應用程式中，Things 在設計與功能結合方面表現最優，除了幾乎具備所有其他用戶應用程式的強大功能外，還有著永遠不會干擾您工作的愉悅介面。」
—Wirecutter, 紐約時報


主要功能

• 您的待辦事項
以強大的「待辦事項」為基本組成部分 — 每一則待辦事項都是邁向大成就的一小步。您可以為其添加備註、加上標籤、安排時程，或者再將其細分成更小的步驟。

• 您的專案
為任何重大目標建立專案，再添加待辦事項以完成目標。在進行規劃時，使用標目讓清單更井井有條。還有一個地方可以寫下備註，並可以訂定完成時限以掌控進度。

• 您的領域
將人生的各個不同部分設為「領域」，例如工作、家庭、理財等等。這讓一切井井有條，並讓您在處理細節時仍能看清全局。

• 您的計劃
您的日程安排的所有內容都整齊地排列在「今天」和「即將到來」清單中，顯示待辦事項和行事曆事件。每天早上，查看今天計劃並決定想做什麼。


更多您會喜愛的內容

進一步熟悉後，您會發現 Things 還有許多其他有用的功能。僅在此舉些例子：

• 提醒事項 — 設定時間後 Things 便會自動提醒您。

• 快速輸入— 只要一想到一件事便可以隨時從任何地方建立待辦事項。
• 快速查找 — 立即找到待辦事項、標目或標籤。
• 輸入任意門 — 利用鍵盤從一個清單跳到另一個清單，只需開始鍵入！
• 小工具 — 在桌面上或「通知中心」中看見您的清單。
• 郵寄至 Things — 將電子郵件轉發到 Things，變成待辦事項。
• Markdown — 為筆記加上層級與樣式。


專為 MAC 設計

Things 專為 Mac 量身訂製並有深度系統整合。快速從其他應用程式建立待辦事項、連接您的行事曆、添加各式小工具、從提醒事項匯入—Things 無所不能！甚至有內建捷徑讓您自動化工作流。

Things 因其出色的設計而獲得許多讚譽，包括兩次獲得蘋果設計獎。每個細節都經過深思熟慮，並力求完善。

—Apple


現在就用 THINGS

無論您想在生活中完成什麼，Things 都能幫助您達到目標。現在就安裝應用程式，看看您能做些什麼！

mo.description:
Aviation Maintenance Tools is a professional maintenance reference app for aircraft technicians, focused on A320 troubleshooting and ECAM reset procedures.
It provides fast, structured access to key information used during fault troubleshooting, reset procedures, structural damage report creation, and everyday maintenance tasks—helping technicians work more efficiently on the line or in base maintenance.

ECAM Fault Messages

• Extensive database of fault messages with the associated circuit breakers (CBs) required for each A320 ECAM reset
• Images of aircraft panels showing where to find each circuit breaker
• Clear, step-by-step ECAM reset procedures with an integrated countdown
• Maintenance manual and MEL references linked to each message

Quick Fault Search

• Instantly find messages using a fast search engine, reducing time-consuming searches during line maintenance calls
• Browse messages organized by ATA chapter
• Recent tab for quick access to previously viewed content

Avionics Tour

• Interactive photo tour of the A320neo avionics compartment
• Navigate through AFT, FWD, LH MID and RH MID bays with real aircraft photos
• Tap any LRU marker to view its name, location and technical description
• Built-in search to quickly find any unit across the compartment

Structural Damage Reports

• Interactive structural damage report forms generator with support for multiple damage entries, eliminating paper notes and improving handover
• Useful for reporting a single damage or multiple damages (e.g., after lightning events)
• Attach damage photos taken with the device camera
• Export reports to PDF or ZIP files (including images) to continue working on a computer or another phone with the app

Alpha Callups

• Complete list of Alpha Callups, filtered by engine model
• Built-in search engine for quick searches

Electrical Contacts

• Electrical contacts, terminals, and splices part numbers library, with quick search function
• Direct reference to the ESPM figure where each item is located
• Crimping and insertion/extraction references included

Common Part Numbers

• Commonly used aircraft part numbers organized by category and aircraft zone
• Each part number can include a description and photos
• Add your own part numbers with photos taken using the device camera
• Create and share your custom part-number list with colleagues
• Useful for quickly finding references during line maintenance

Maintenance Manual References

• Structured breakdown of the maintenance manual index
• Fast search for quick lookup

Disclaimer – Training & Reference Use Only

This app is designed for training, reference, and informational purposes only.
This app does not replace official documentation. Fault messages, reset procedures, structural damage reports, manual/MEL/ESPM references, electrical contact data, and part number information are provided as a learning aid for maintenance technicians.
Users must always consult the latest official manuals and procedures before performing any maintenance or operational task on an aircraft.
This app must not be used as the sole source for maintenance decisions.

This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or an official product of any aircraft manufacturer.
The app does not copy, reproduce, or distribute proprietary manufacturer materials (including manual pages or documentation) and does not use manufacturer logos or branding.

THINGS 3.23

重複的待辦事項變得靈活許多，帶來兩項呼聲很高的改進：現在你可以提前完成它們，也能在計畫有變時輕鬆改期！此外，App 各處還有許多細部改良。


提前完成重複的待辦事項

有時候你的進度超前，想提早把某件事勾掉。現在可以了！重複的待辦事項現在會顯示一般的複選框——就和其他待辦事項一樣——因此事情一做好，你馬上就能把它完成。


輕鬆改期

重複的待辦事項現在可以改期了，讓你在計畫有變時能輕鬆調整。只要把它移到新的日期就好。如果它是定期重複的，Things 會詢問你是要建立一次性例外，還是要更新往後的重複規則。如果它是完成後才重複的，就會直接移到新的日期。


更多細部改良

我們還為重複的待辦事項做了其他多項細部改良：

• 重複待辦事項的設定對話框換上了新外觀，也讓你更容易挑選下一次的重複日期。
• 重複待辦事項的副本現在會顯示一個小小的灰色重複圖示，以便與一般的待辦事項區分。
• 如果你想提前開始處理重複的專案，現在可以了！只要你一開始編輯其中的待辦事項，Things 就會詢問你是否要提前建立專案的下一個副本。
• 你可以手動提前建立重複待辦事項的下一個副本：以右鍵點按它，然後選擇「重複 > 建立下一個副本」。
• 你現在可以一次暫停、重新繼續或停止多件重複的待辦事項。
• 更多錯誤修正與改進——完整的更新說明請見我們的網站。

---

最後值得一提的是，這次更新還包含一項我們已投入一段時間的重大底層改動：待辦事項的顯示與編輯——無論是在清單中，還是在你展開它們時——在 Mac 與 iOS 上現在都由同一套程式碼驅動。

---

mo.description:
把事情做好！獲獎肯定的 Things 應用程式幫助您規劃一天行程、管理專案，並幫助您按部就班地朝目標邁進。

除了強大的功能外，最厲害的是，使用起來非常簡單方便。在短時間內理清瑣事，無論是基本任務還是偉大的人生目標都頓時變得井然有序，然後開始專注在今天最重要的事情上。

「在所有我們測試過的應用程式中，Things 在設計與功能結合方面表現最優，除了幾乎具備所有其他用戶應用程式的強大功能外，還有著永遠不會干擾您工作的愉悅介面。」
—Wirecutter, 紐約時報


主要功能

• 您的待辦事項
以強大的「待辦事項」為基本組成部分 — 每一則待辦事項都是邁向大成就的一小步。您可以為其添加備註、加上標籤、安排時程，或者再將其細分成更小的步驟。

• 您的專案
為任何重大目標建立專案，再添加待辦事項以完成目標。在進行規劃時，使用標目讓清單更井井有條。還有一個地方可以寫下備註，並可以訂定完成時限以掌控進度。

• 您的領域
將人生的各個不同部分設為「領域」，例如工作、家庭、理財等等。這讓一切井井有條，並讓您在處理細節時仍能看清全局。

• 您的計劃
您的日程安排的所有內容都整齊地排列在「今天」和「即將到來」清單中，顯示待辦事項和行事曆事件。每天早上，查看今天計劃並決定想做什麼。


更多您會喜愛的內容

進一步熟悉後，您會發現 Things 還有許多其他有用的功能。僅在此舉些例子：

• 提醒事項 — 設定時間後 Things 便會自動提醒您。
• 重複 — 自動依據您設定的時間表重複待辦事項。
• 今晚 — 特別讓您安排今晚計劃。
• 行事曆整合 — 同時查看事件與待辦事項。
• 標籤 — 將待辦事項分類並快速篩選清單。
• 快速輸入— 只要一想到一件事便可以隨時從任何地方建立待辦事項。
• 快速查找 — 立即找到待辦事項、標目或標籤。
• 輸入任意門 — 利用鍵盤從一個清單跳到另一個清單，只需開始鍵入！
• 小工具 — 在桌面上或「通知中心」中看見您的清單。
• 郵寄至 Things — 將電子郵件轉發到 Things，變成待辦事項。
• Markdown — 為筆記加上層級與樣式。


專為 MAC 設計

Things 專為 Mac 量身訂製並有深度系統整合。快速從其他應用程式建立待辦事項、連接您的行事曆、添加各式小工具、從提醒事項匯入—Things 無所不能！甚至有內建捷徑讓您自動化工作流。


獲獎設計

Things 因其出色的設計而獲得許多讚譽，包括兩次獲得蘋果設計獎。每個細節都經過深思熟慮，並力求完善。

「簡直是生產力工具界的獨角獸：足夠深入以完成嚴肅的工作，又不可思議地易於使用，精美的設計令人光是看著也著迷。」
—Apple


現在就用 THINGS

無論您想在生活中完成什麼，Things 都能幫助您達到目標。現在就安裝應用程式，看看您能做些什麼！

• Things 亦推出 iPad、iPhone、Apple Watch 與 Apple Vision Pro 版（分開銷售）。
• 透過 Things Cloud 服務免費同步。
• 提供 Mac 免費試用版：www.things.app

若有任何問題，敬請與我們聯繫。我們將很樂意提供協助。

《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

Aviation Maintenance Tools is a professional maintenance reference app for aircraft technicians, focused on A320 troubleshooting and ECAM reset procedures.
It provides fast, structured access to key information used during fault troubleshooting, reset procedures, structural damage report creation, and everyday maintenance tasks—helping technicians work more efficiently on the line or in base maintenance.

ECAM Fault Messages

• Extensive database of fault messages with the associated circuit breakers (CBs) required for each A320 ECAM reset
• Images of aircraft panels showing where to find each circuit breaker
• Clear, step-by-step ECAM reset procedures with an integrated countdown
• Maintenance manual and MEL references linked to each message

Quick Fault Search

• Instantly find messages using a fast search engine, reducing time-consuming searches during line maintenance calls
• Browse messages organized by ATA chapter
• Recent tab for quick access to previously viewed content

Avionics Tour

• Interactive photo tour of the A320neo avionics compartment
• Navigate through AFT, FWD, LH MID and RH MID bays with real aircraft photos
• Tap any LRU marker to view its name, location and technical description
• Built-in search to quickly find any unit across the compartment

Structural Damage Reports

• Interactive structural damage report forms generator with support for multiple damage entries, eliminating paper notes and improving handover
• Useful for reporting a single damage or multiple damages (e.g., after lightning events)
• Attach damage photos taken with the device camera
• Export reports to PDF or ZIP files (including images) to continue working on a computer or another phone with the app

Alpha Callups

• Complete list of Alpha Callups, filtered by engine model
• Built-in search engine for quick searches

Electrical Contacts

• Electrical contacts, terminals, and splices part numbers library, with quick search function
• Direct reference to the ESPM figure where each item is located
• Crimping and insertion/extraction references included

Common Part Numbers

• Commonly used aircraft part numbers organized by category and aircraft zone
• Each part number can include a description and photos
• Add your own part numbers with photos taken using the device camera
• Create and share your custom part-number list with colleagues
• Useful for quickly finding references during line maintenance

Maintenance Manual References

• Structured breakdown of the maintenance manual index
• Fast search for quick lookup

Disclaimer – Training & Reference Use Only

This app does not replace official documentation. Fault messages, reset procedures, structural damage reports, manual/MEL/ESPM references, electrical contact data, and part number information are provided as a learning aid for maintenance technicians.
Users must always consult the latest official manuals and procedures before performing any maintenance or operational task on an aircraft.
This app must not be used as the sole source for maintenance decisions.

為任何重大目標建立專案，再添加待辦事項以完成目標。在進行規劃時，使用標目讓清單更井井有條。還有一個地方可以寫下備註，並可以訂定完成時限以掌控進度。

THINGS 3.23

Repeating to-dos just got far more flexible, with two highly requested improvements: You can now complete them early, and easily reschedule them when plans change! Plus many more refinements throughout.


COMPLETE REPEATING TO-DOS EARLY

Sometimes you’re ahead of schedule and want to tick something off early. Now you can! A repeating to-do now shows a normal checkbox – just like any other to-do – so you can complete it as soon as it’s done.


RESCHEDULE WITH EASE

Repeating to-dos can now be rescheduled, which makes it easy to adapt when plans change. Simply bump it to a new date. If it repeats on a fixed schedule, Things will ask whether you want to make a one-time exception, or update the rule going forward. If it repeats after completion, it simply moves to the new date.


MORE REFINEMENTS

We’ve made a number of other refinements to repeating to-dos:

• The repeating to-do setup dialog has received a visual refresh, and lets you more easily pick the next recurrence date.
• A copy of a repeating to-do now shows a little gray repeat icon to distinguish it from regular to-dos.
• If you want to start working on a repeating project early, you now can! As soon as you start editing its to-dos, Things will offer to create the next copy of the project ahead of time.
• You can manually create the next copy of a repeating to-do ahead of time by right-clicking it and choosing Repeat > Create Next Copy.
• You can now pause, resume, and stop multiple repeating to-dos at once.
• More bug fixes and improvements – see our website for the full release notes.

---

Last but not least, this update includes a big change under the hood that we’ve been working on for some time: the display and editing of to-dos – both inside lists and when you expand them – is now driven by the same code on Mac and iOS.

Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.

Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today.

“Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.”
—Wirecutter, The New York Times


KEY FEATURES

• Your To-Dos
Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps.

• Your Projects
Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule.

• Your Areas
Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion.

Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :)

• Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you.
• Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set.
• This Evening — a special place for your evening plans.

AWARD-WINNING DESIGN

“It’s like the unicorn of productivity tools: deep enough for serious work, surprisingly easy to use, and gorgeous enough to enjoy staring at.”

사진 꾸미기를 어렵게 시작할 필요 없어요. CHAKK(챡)은 인스타 스토리부터 일상 사진, 영상까지 쉽고 재미있게 꾸밀 수 있는 사진 꾸미기 앱이에요.

3,000개+ 감성 스티커를 바로 복사해 붙이고, 원하는 문구로 말풍선을 만들고, 좋아하는 사진은 나만의 스티커로 만들어보세요. 사진·영상 프레임, 배경 제거, 문자티콘까지 스꾸에 필요한 기능을 한곳에 담았어요. 

고르고, 만들고, 복사하고, 챡! 어렵지 않은 사꾸 CHAKK 하나면 사진 꾸미기 완성!

3초 사용법
- 챡 앱에서 사진에 어울리는 스티커를 골라요
- Instagram 스토리에서 입력란을 꾹 눌러 ‘붙여넣기’ 하면 완성!
- 아이폰 마크업(올가미) 기능으로도 앨범에서 스티커를 붙일 수 있어요

CHAKK으로 할 수 있는 것
1. 3,000개+ 자체제작 스티커
- CHAKK에서 직접 만든 다양한 감성 스티커를 만나보세요
- 일상, 여행, 맛집, 연애, 밈, 감정 표현 등 다양한 순간에 어울리는 스티커를 계속 업데이트하고 있어요
- 원하는 스티커를 누르면 바로 복사되어 간편하게 사용할 수 있어요

2. 나만의 말풍선 스티커 만들기
- 하고 싶은 말을 말풍선에 쏙 담아보세요
- 다양한 말풍선 디자인과 폰트, 색상을 조합해 원하는 스타일로 만들 수 있어요
- 직접 만든 말풍선 스티커를 복사해 인스타 스토리, 사진, 이미지에 바로 붙여보세요

4. 갤러리 사진으로 나만의 스티커 만들기
- 앨범 속 사진과 이미지를 나만의 스티커로 만들어보세요
- 좋아하는 짤과 최애 사진을 스티커팩별로 모아 관리할 수 있어요
- 만든 스티커는 필요할 때 바로 복사해서 사용할 수 있어요
- 사진의 배경을 제거해 원하는 부분만 스티커로 만들 수 있어요
- 내가 만든 스티커는 챡 앱에 저장해 언제든 다시 사용할 수 있어요

4. 사진·영상 프레임으로 사꾸
- 평범한 사진과 영상도 프레임 하나로 색다르게 꾸며보세요
- 다양한 이미지 프레임을 활용해 사진 꾸미기부터 인스타 스토리 꾸미기까지 간편하게 완성할 수 있어요
- 좋아하는 사진을 프레임에 넣고 나만의 감성으로 사꾸해보세요.

5. 문자티콘 & 꾸미기 텍스트
- 귀여운 카오모지부터 특수문자, 문자티콘까지 간편하게 복사해보세요
- 감정을 표현하는 문자티콘과 텍스트 꾸미기로 인스타 프로필, 스토리, 메모와 메시지에도 포인트를 더할 수 있어요

6. 사진부터 영상까지 자유롭게
- 사진뿐 아니라 영상 제작에 사용할 이미지와 꾸미기 리소스도 만들어보세요
- 직접 만든 스티커, 말풍선, 프레임 이미지를 활용해 다양한 콘텐츠를 꾸밀 수 있어요
- 일상 기록부터 SNS 콘텐츠까지, 필요한 꾸미기를 CHAKK에서 간편하게 시작해보세요
- CHAKK에서 제공하는 스티커는 이용 범위 내에서 상업적 콘텐츠에도 활용할 수 있어요

7. 다양한 언어와 기기 지원
- 영어, 일본어, 중국어를 새롭게 지원해요
- iPhone은 물론 iPad와 Mac에서도 CHAKK을 만나보세요
- 사진과 콘텐츠를 꾸미고 싶은 순간 더 편리하게 사용할 수 있어요

이런 순간에 사용해보세요
- 인스타 스토리에 올릴 사진이 살짝 심심할 때
- 여행, 맛집, 데이트와 소소한 일상을 더 귀엽게 기록하고 싶을 때

- 갤러리 속 최애 사진과 이미지를 나만의 스티커로 만들고 싶을 때
- 자주 사용하는 짤과 이미지를 한곳에 모아두고 싶을 때
- 하고 싶은 말을 나만의 말풍선 스티커에 담고 싶을 때
- 인스타 피드와 스토리에 나만의 감성을 더하고 싶을 때
- 문자티콘과 특수문자로 메시지와 SNS를 꾸미고 싶을 때
- 다꾸처럼 사진도 내 취향대로 꾸미고 싶을 때
- 영상과 SNS 콘텐츠에 사용할 꾸미기 이미지를 만들고 싶을 때

CHAKK에 모아두고 복붙하면 끝!

pt.description:
Polygon: "My Child Lebensborn relata um conto perturbador sobre inocentes após o fim da II Guerra.”
LevelUp: “A experiência de jogo mais impactante que eu já tive.”

Você adota uma criança Lebensborn na Noruega após a II Guerra Mundial, mas educá-la será difícil, já que seu filho estará crescendo um um ambiente hostil e cheio de ódio. Você consegue ajudar Klaus a lidar com o pesado fardo da herança da ocupação alemã, para que ele encontre seu lugar em um país que está celebrando sua liberdade?

Você pode fazer a diferença.

My Child Lebensborn é uma montanha-russa emocional que ganhou um BAFTA na categoria "Game Beyond Entertainment" por sua jogabilidade original e sua dilacerante simulação da relação pais-filhos. O jogo desafiou milhões de jogadores a vivenciar o quão difícil é manter uma criança segura quando ela é vista como símbolo de um inimigo odiado.

Veja um lado diferente da guerra, inspirado pelas histórias reais das crianças Lebensborn. Descubra como o ódio pelos nossos inimigos continua a criar vítimas, mesmo após a vitória. Descubra seu passado e apoie-o no presente. Você precisa equilibrar seu tempo e recursos para poder sustentar seu filho. Você irá encontrar respostas às questões difíceis, sobre sua história, o ódio, o bullying e o passar da culpa.

Principais funcionalidades:
- Adote um menino e suporte-o durante um ano que vai definir sua vida.
- Influenciar os sentimentos da criança, sua pesonalidade e visão do mundo através de suas escolhas.
- Ganhar dinheiro trabalhando, e depois cozinhe, construa, colha alimentos e brinque com seu filho.
- Use seu tempo e escassos recursos com inteligência.
- Investigar o efeito de suas escolhas nas expressões e linguagem corporal de seu filho.
- Explorar uma narrativa envolvente, baseada em eventos reais.

Parte dos lucros do jogo é destinada a ajudar a proteger os Children Born of War (crianças nascidas de soldados inimigos e mulheres locais).

Aviso: Este jogo inclui descrições de bullying e abuso.

Para apoio técnico, contate-nos em support@sareptastudio.com

Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.

Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today.

“Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.”
—Wirecutter, The New York Times


KEY FEATURES

• Your To-Dos
Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps.

• Your Projects
Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule.

• Your Areas
Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion.

• Your Plan
Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :)


MORE THINGS TO LOVE

As you dive deeper, you’ll find Things packed with helpful features. Here are just a few:

• Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you.
• Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set.
• This Evening — a special place for your evening plans.
• Calendar integration — see your events and to-dos together.
• Tags — categorize your to-dos and quickly filter lists.
• Quick Entry — create to-dos from anywhere, as soon as the thought hits you.
• Quick Find — instantly locate to-dos, headings, or tags.
• Type Travel — jump from list to list with your keyboard; just start typing!
• Widgets — see your lists on the desktop or in Notification Center.
• Mail to Things — forward an email to Things; now it’s a to-do.
• Markdown — structure & style your notes.
• And much more!


MADE FOR MAC

Things is tailored to the Mac with deep system integrations as well. A great example is Quick Entry with Autofill: a shortcut that grabs content from other apps and adds it to Things for you, such as a link to a website or an email you want to get back to.

You can also enjoy a beautiful dark mode at sunset, connect your calendars, open multiple windows, add a variety of widgets, import from Reminders—Things can do it all! There’s even Shortcuts integration if you want to automate your workflows.


STAY PRODUCTIVE ON THE GO

Things also has full-featured apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro (sold separately). All your devices sync seamlessly via our free Things Cloud service. It’s great to have everything at your fingertips when you need it!


AWARD-WINNING DESIGN

Made in Stuttgart, with two Apple Design Awards to its name, Things is a fine example of German engineering: designed not only to look fantastic, but to be perfectly functional as well. Every detail is thoughtfully considered, then polished to perfection.

“It’s like the unicorn of productivity tools: deep enough for serious work, surprisingly easy to use, and gorgeous enough to enjoy staring at.”
—Apple


GET THINGS TODAY

Whatever it is you want to accomplish in life, Things can help you get there. Install the app today and see what you can do!

Visit our website now and get a free 15-day trial for your Mac: www.things.app

If you have any questions, please get in touch. We provide professional support and will be glad to help you!

Repeating to-dos just got far more flexible, with two highly requested improvements: You can now complete them early, and easily reschedule them when plans change! Plus many more refinements throughout.


COMPLETE REPEATING TO-DOS EARLY

Sometimes you’re ahead of schedule and want to tick something off early. Now you can! A repeating to-do now shows a normal checkbox – just like any other to-do – so you can complete it as soon as it’s done.


RESCHEDULE WITH EASE

Repeating to-dos can now be rescheduled, which makes it easy to adapt when plans change. Simply bump it to a new date. If it repeats on a fixed schedule, Things will ask whether you want to make a one-time exception, or update the rule going forward. If it repeats after completion, it simply moves to the new date.


MORE REFINEMENTS

We’ve made a number of other refinements to repeating to-dos:

• The repeating to-do setup dialog has received a visual refresh, and lets you more easily pick the next recurrence date.
• A copy of a repeating to-do now shows a little gray repeat icon to distinguish it from regular to-dos.
• If you want to start working on a repeating project early, you now can! As soon as you start editing its to-dos, Things will offer to create the next copy of the project ahead of time.
• You can manually create the next copy of a repeating to-do ahead of time by right-clicking it and choosing Repeat > Create Next Copy.
• You can now pause, resume, and stop multiple repeating to-dos at once.
• More bug fixes and improvements – see our website for the full release notes.

---

Last but not least, this update includes a big change under the hood that we’ve been working on for some time: the display and editing of to-dos – both inside lists and when you expand them – is now driven by the same code on Mac and iOS.

---

Things now requires macOS 13.3 or later.
